pages.title: Fractured Essence
pages.text: A splinter of reality that broke away from a destabilised creature. It is in several places at once, flickering between them, and it is never quite where I expect it. It feels like a shard of glass whose edges keep moving.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I first picked these up after a Destabilised Husk came apart in front of me. The splinters kept flickering in and out of my pocket until I put them in a jar.

Made in $(item)Chronon Field Inverter$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Destabilised Husk.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Contained Anomaly Specimen, Degenerate Matter Chunk, Fracture Ward, Integer Ring, Strange Matter Pellet, Warm Helium, Xenogenome Sample.
